summary: Restore the corpus consonant order in tuhzimo
rationale: The supplied verse 29/104 has w tuhzimo gabayna, with z before m. The glossary reverses these consonants in tuhmizo. The permitted lookup also attests tuhzimo under hzm.III. This proposal changes the consonant order only; the root-level issue is raised separately.

summary: Does hmz result from a metathesis error for existing hzm?
rationale: This entry has only one example; its supplied corpus verse 29/104 reads tuhzimo, pointing to hzm rather than hmz. The existing hzm.III entry has mahzamle/mahzəm, sense 2 entführen, and the infinitive tuhzimo at 26/185. Check whether hmz and its reconstructed forms mahmazle/mahməz should be removed as a spurious duplicate and the example assigned to hzm.III sense 2. The available evidence does not independently attest an hmz variant, so no automatic merger is asserted.
